title: Compass task.yml
description: The machine-readable task spine. Lives at .compass/work/<task-slug>/task.yml. The human-readable companion is task.reference.yml.

schema_version.description: The Compass task.yml schema version this file follows. The CLI warns/fails on incompatible versions. Optional in 1.0 for back-compat; recommended. '1.1' introduced the optional `status` and `land_timestamp` fields.

task.description: The task slug; matches the directory name.

created.description: ISO date the task was framed.

status.description: Optional. Lifecycle status of the task. 'active' (default when absent) means in-flight; 'queued' means recorded as next up but not started; 'parked' means stopped with the phases so far still valid, so it can resume; 'landed' means Land completed and its scenarios are eligible for the living system spec derivation (ADR-008, DD-3); 'abandoned' means it will not resume. Only 'landed' grants derivation eligibility - every other value is ineligible, so a new value can never silently acquire it. Tasks with schema_version '1.0' that lack this field are treated as 'active' (Inv-8 backward compat).

land_timestamp.description: Optional. ISO 8601 timestamp of when the task was Landed. Written by scripts/integrate.sh alongside status: landed. Used as the primary sort key for the living spec derivation order (ADR-008 §3).

readings.description: The four-dimension judgement readings the Needle produces at Frame.

route.description: The final route; filled by `compass route evaluate --write`.

phases.description: phase name -> weight string; filled by route evaluate.

evidence.description: The task's evidence registry - typed, id-tagged entries gates reference by id. Built incrementally across phases.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. EV-001 or EV-A1.

path.description: Path to the evidence file (relative to the task dir, or absolute).

scenario.description: Scenario id this evidence is FOR (when applicable).

scope.description: For human-approval: what the approval is for.

decision.description: For human-approval: pending | approved | rejected. For spike-conclusion: discard | graduate-to-delivery | defer.

conditions.description: For human-approval: any conditions attached to the approval.

next_task.description: For spike-conclusion with decision=graduate-to-delivery: the path to the new task that owns the delivery work (e.g. .compass/work/<new-slug>/).

gates.description: Seeded by route evaluate (status pending); each phase updates the gates it clears.

evidence.description: When status is `pass`, a list of evidence ids referencing entries in the top-level `evidence` registry. `null` or empty until cleared.

scenarios.description: The machine-readable index of spec.feature.md; filled by Specify.

intent.description: The intent id(s) this scenario traces to - a string or a list of strings (a scenario may serve more than one intent).

group.description: Independence group seeding the distribution map.

verifiable.description: Scenario taxonomy, e.g. 'narrative' for a documentation-as-acceptance playbook.

superseded_by.description: Optional. Scenario id(s) that replace this one. blueprint-distillation names silent supersession as an anti-pattern: a target scenario replacing a distilled baseline is a recorded decision, not a silent overwrite. Without the link a reader cannot tell a baseline that failed because the change landed as intended from one that failed because something broke.

changed_files.description: Every production file the task changes, each traced to >=1 scenario id; filled by Build.

claims.description: Public/marketing claims, each traced to a backing scenario; filled by Position.

backfills.description: Owed ceremony (e.g. a Hotfix's). `compass check` fails while any is unpaid.

target_task.description: Cross-task backfill: the task whose Land is blocked until this is paid.

paid_at.description: Optional audit field: when the backfill was paid.

paid_note.description: Optional audit field: a note recorded when paying.

reframes.description: Append-only log of re-frames (compass route evaluate --reframe). Feeds the Needle's calibration signal.

friction.description: Optional. Written at Land. Records where Compass's own ceremony cost more than it returned between Frame and Land, and how the framework could have been configured to avoid it. A strategy-class signal (soft, advisory) - never gates Land. Absent on tasks that hit no friction; the loop no-ops cleanly for projects that never write it (ADR-006). Aggregated by `compass calibration --friction`.

phase.description: The pipeline phase the friction was felt in.

category.description: What kind of friction this was.

observation.description: What got in the way, stated concretely.

proposed_change.description: How the framework could have been configured to avoid it - the aggregation key.

source.description: derived: assembled automatically at Land from reframes/reframe-debt. human: supplied by the author.

repairs.description: Hotfix routes only: the slug of the task this hotfix repairs. Read by `compass calibration --impact` to compute the change-fail signal. Optional - a hotfix that declares none is reported as a coverage gap rather than silently counted as zero.

parked_reason.description: Optional. Why a parked task was set aside - the thing a reader needs to decide whether to resume it.

parked_at.description: Optional. ISO-8601 timestamp recording when the task was parked.
